title: Easy Onion Puff Pastry Tart
subtitle: with Kalamata olives and oregano
description: Sweet softened onions, salty Kalamata olives, oregano and parmesan on crisp puff pastry. Simple and good with a salad.

steps.text: Important: thaw the puff pastry in the fridge overnight before you start.
Halve the onions and slice each half thinly.
Sweat the onions in the butter and olive oil in a wide, shallow pot over medium heat until soft and translucent, taking care not to burn. Set aside to cool.
Preheat the oven to 190°C on fan-forced.

Cut the thawed pastry into 2 rectangles and place each on a tray lined with baking paper. Spread the onions over both, leaving only a thin border bare. Scatter over the sliced Kalamata olives (not too many, they are salty), grate a little parmesan over and add fresh oregano leaves.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, until golden and the base is cooked (check the onion is not burning).
Remove from the oven, grate over a little more parmesan, cut and serve.
